ns2:section.sectionText: This section is an online course. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting in late April or early May to cover logistics and address any questions. Registration restricted to Business Majors and Actuarial Science majors and specific Agri-Finance concentrations.. Any remaining seats will open to Business Minor students and all interested students at approximately noon on Monday, April 22. PREREQUISITES WILL BE ENFORCED.
